units: Sabb. XVII, 6 ז׳ שהיא וכ׳ a rod which is tied to a pitcher (to let it down into the well); a. e.—Esp. the rod as an officer’s badge and punishing instrument.
Num. R. s. 18 וליתן לו ז׳ and to give him the rod (appoint him an officer).—בעל הז׳ carrier of the rod (among the Romans Centurio, v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
<cite ref="Shabbat 145b:14">Sabb. 145ᵇ</cite> <he>ובעלי ז׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ובעל</he>) and Centuriones, v. <cite ref="E00074"><he>הֶגְמוֹן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:12:4">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ</cite> top (rank of officers) <he>בעל האגמון בעל הז׳ וכ׳</he> cane-bearer, rod-bearer, strap-bearer; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:7">Tosef. ib. XV, 7</cite> (variously corrupted, v. Var. in ed. Zuck.).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 73:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIII</cite>, end; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 808:8">Yalk. ib. 808</cite>.
Ex. R. s. 21, end; a. fr.—Pl. זְמוֹרוֹת.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite>, end <he>ז׳ לפילים</he> vine-rods as food for elephants; <he>ז׳ לנטיעות</he> shoots for future plantation.

senses.gloss: membrum virile, phallus. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 10 the Israelites did not know מה טיבה של ז׳ the idolatrous function of the phallus (with ref. to Ez. VIII, 17).
units: <cite ref="Ezekiel 8:17">Ib.</cite> <he>חיכך … את הז׳</he> Esau giggled and produced the phallus; Pesik. Zakhor, p. 27ᵇ.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 7:1">Pesik. R. s. 7</cite> <he>בחירופיו … ובז׳</he> with his (Amalek’s) blasphemies and by throwing up the phallus (taken from the mutilated Israelitish bodies).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 7:1">Ib.</cite> <he>זְמוֹרָתָם של וכ׳</he> the membra of Israelites; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:3">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>(זַכְרוּתָן</he>).
